API Documentation for External Notification Handler

items.docs: Send Event This endpoint allows clients to notify their consumers via WhatsApp about order status updates. Allowed Events The following values are allowed for the event field: order_created picking_started picked_out enroute_to_dropoff at_dropoff delivered If you require additional custom events, please contact us to discuss adding them to the system. Note: The required parameters may vary depending on the event type. Each event corresponds to specific message templates and required parameters.
